profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with over a decade of experience building web applications.

Currently at Hertz working on the car rental booking flow; previously 6+ years at Qualia building rate calculators, compliance tools, and integrations in the title/real estate space.

I'm interested in manufacturing, particularly helping small shops improve efficiency and stay competitive.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led frontend development on Value Added Services team, contributing to $110M revenue increase over 2 years.
• Introduced Scrum framework and sprint planning to improve team workflow; led retrospectives and co-led ideation sessions.
• Partnered with data science team to design and execute experiments, translating insights into production features.
• Built and maintained automated QA pipeline, reducing regression issues and accelerating release cycles.
• Won 1st place in company-wide hackathon.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesigned a Ruby-based legacy system for underwriter API integrations with a modern TypeScript
stack, improving reliability and maintainability.
• Built a self-service application to enable underwriters to manage mappings of their products with
internal IDs, reducing support volume and time to resolution.
• Enhanced the legacy application supporting 20+ API integrations by addressing technical debt, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
• Created the initial automated mapping system for underwriter products, reducing manual efforts and
support volume by 25%.
• Led initiatives to improve the reliability and maintainability of a legacy application by enhancing test
coverage and observability.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
• Founded and led development of consumer skincare tracking app from concept through launch, managing $150K budget across design, engineering, and brand development.
• Coordinated cross-functional team of freelance developers, designers, and contractors to ship application.
• Conducted user research and iterated on product based on customer feedback; ultimately wound down after validating market fit challenges.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed the front end of the employee referral platform using React.js.
• Created a reusable UI component library with the lead designer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Parsed data from various sources to populate feeds on the app’s home screen.
• Built data processing pipeline for user query and interaction data.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
NASDAQ: FUEL

• Built a dashboard to help monitor the status of the company’s ETL pipeline.
• Reduced latency on location-based queries and the redundancy of data.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Conducted research on a conjecture in edge coloring in graph theory.
• Wrote scripts to automate the generation of random graphs and check for constraints.
